free_tier.stated: GTS is currently available to researchers from the European network research community with an endorsement from their local NREN, and to GN4-3 project users with an endorsement from their work package leader. There are no costs, but quotas apply to how many resources a user can use, and registering a project asks for a brief description of the planned work.

limits.value: No cost, but entry needs an endorsement from a national research and education network plus a project description, and quotas are set by the operator, so a person with no NREN affiliation cannot request a VM.
